taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Gatekeeper/Kyverno policy exception and mutation trust
controls.source_trace: Trace who may change exceptions, selectors or authority-bearing labels and whether mutation creates a post-validation privilege difference.
controls.implementation_branch: Identify the engine/version and whether a namespace, label or exception object exempts a resource. Check who can create that exception and whether admission protects the exemption metadata. Mutation and validation ordering can change the final admitted object; a policy report in audit mode is not an enforced deny control.
controls.operational_method: Choose the actual engine before constructing the exception case. For Kyverno inspect PolicyException availability, exception namespace/admission rules and which policies/rules it matches. For Gatekeeper inspect the applicable exclusion configuration and excluded namespaces/processes, rather than inventing a Kyverno-style object. Record the restricted actor allowed to alter the exemption and the final admission decision for one otherwise forbidden owned object; audit-only reports are not enforced denial.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned local cluster with a harmless policy marker; compare an approved exception and a lower-trust exception/label change.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An explicit administrator-controlled exception is intended authority; policy names alone do not prove enforcement.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain exception writers and evaluate the final admitted object, preserving intended workload exceptions.
